name: Etched Note
summary: At Camp Narache, the Etched Note calls a young tauren hunter to begin training. Lanka Farshot, the camp's hunter trainer, welcomes the novice to the traditions of the hunt.

sections.title: A Call to the Hunt
sections.body: At Camp Narache, a runner brings young shu'halo a message from Lanka Farshot, the camp's hunter trainer. The note names the hunter the heart of the tribe. It also warns that natural instinct needs rigorous instruction and deep respect for Mulgore's wilderness.

sections.title: Traditions of the Shu'halo
sections.body: For the tauren, hunting is a sacred discipline and a way of survival, woven into tribal life. Hunters join the work of warriors, shamans and druids, and the tribe looks to them for guidance and protection. The student presents the note to Lanka to begin learning weaponcraft and how to understand beasts, preparing to defend and sustain the tribes.

faq.q: What is the purpose of the Etched Note?
aliases: why did i get etched note
faq.answer: The Etched Note calls a novice tauren hunter to present themselves to Lanka Farshot at Camp Narache. There, formal training begins in marksmanship and beast lore.
Lanka Farshot, the hunter trainer at Camp Narache, wrote the note. He sends couriers across the mesa to find young hunters ready to learn.

faq.q: Why is hunting so important to the tauren?
faq.answer: Hunting sustains tauren survival, spirituality and tribal tradition. Skilled hunters provide food and materials while living in balance with the land and honoring the spirits of the beasts they fell.

faq.q: Where should this note be brought?
aliases: where do i take the note
who do i turn this in to
faq.answer: Bring the Etched Note to Lanka Farshot near the pavilion and training grounds at Camp Narache on the Red Cloud Mesa.

angles.text: As a hunter, the note marks your formal entry into the hunter tradition. Lanka's lessons teach you to handle ranged weapons and commune with the beasts of the plains.
As a tauren, you carry the expectations of your elders and bloodline. The note calls you to master Mulgore's rolling grasslands before traveling to distant lands.
